title: School World pt. 2
content: I’m back to elaborate a bit more on my school world experiences, following my original post a while back. In addition to that post, these are some other things I see or themes I encounter while in School World: There is always a big to-do regarding my parking situation upon arriving to school. IRL, I did not have my license in high school so I relied on the bus or rides from friends. Since I’m much older now and have a car, I find myself driving to school and panicking about where I’m going to park. I don’t have the appropriate pass needed. I circle the lot to try and figure out how I can blend in without getting in trouble. Sometimes I illegally park at the nearby Dunkin and walk to school, only to turn around and repark because that doesn’t feel safe either. Once I’m in the school (I can't recall ever walking through the doors, I just appear inside) I find myself in the central "hub" where the main office and auditorium is located. I always get the sense that it's night time or there's a dark storm overhead (no natural light peering in through any windows). The school is a mashup of my high school, middle school & junior high all in one. *I may mention some details from my original post because it helps my mind blend everything together* There is a modular wing of the school with a particular classroom I always end up in. I want to say it's a math class (I always struggled in math)- and to no surprise, I'm struggling even harder in my dream. I was held back or something, I'm the oldest in the class. Most of the classrooms I enter are very large with the desks spread apart but this classroom feels very crammed. The teacher tells us to pull out our homework and I have no idea what they're talking about. Homework? What are we even learning about? I'm pretty sure I missed the last 12 homework assignments. Should I just cut class and drop this course? I'm already way behind. Outside of this classroom, there is a staircase that leads down to a lower level. It's not an ordinary staircase, it's actually a red ladder. Sometimes I take it downstairs. This leads to a hallway where another normal, wide staircase that you'd see in schools is directly in front of me. The stairs going up lead to the library and the stairs going down lead to the gym/lockers/pool. If I head to the gym/lockers/pool, there is a lot of hustle & bustle- I can hear voices and foot steps shuffling to get to class. I pass by a long hall of lockers. Are one of these mine? I forget what floor my locker is on. This lower level can be creepy at times.. especially where the pool resides. The pool also offers no natural light, it's poorly lit with old flickering lights. The pool area connects to this strange room where there's a play area (similar to a McDonald's or Chuckee Cheese) with an indoor jungle gym complete with tunnels and ball pits. I never see anybody occupying this area, as if it's been abandoned. The locker rooms are right around the corner. If I took the staircase up towards the library, this is my first view of natural sunlight. The library is bright and has a spiral staircase in the center with an overlook. I always feel dizzy climbing these stairs and hold on to the floor once I get to the top to avoid tipping over. There's a courtyard right off of the library that leads to a grassy area with sidewalks leading to a separate building of classrooms. These are the science labs. There are bathrooms everywhere- the science lab area even has it's own set right from the sidewalk. Gross and unkept of course.. the doors to the stalls do not cover your face so everyone can see you doing your business. OH and there are actually 2 gyms, there is one on the lower level as described before but there is also one on the main level that seems to be more active. Anytime I enter the gym, there is some sort of assembly or pep rally going on. Although I was not a cheerleader in high school (only in my younger years), I'm always like 'oh shit I have to perform this routine in front of the school'. I'm usually pretty lucid during this part of the dream, so I don't panic too much. I know I'm dreaming so I just have fun with it and steal the show with my mismatched uniform and off beat choreography. I see so many familiar faces in the crowd as I look up. It is SO FUNNY to me how my brain can remember the most random selection of classmates in my dream.. people I have not thought about in years. The layout of the school isn't super confusing, it's a big square. However, sometimes I notice that the square is never ending. I cut corner after corner expecting to end up where I began, but of course dreams can never be that simple. I'm always looking for a particular classroom.. let's say 221. Ok, there's room 219, 220, followed by 222. WHERE IS 221? I go to the guidance counselor for help and fiddle around in my bookbag looking for my schedule. The guidance counselor is less than helpful and more so annoyed with me that I don't know where I'm going. Back outside towards the front of the school, there is a cobblestone driveway with a huge tree house that connects to the main part of the school. It's not really a TREE house, but the building is meant to look like a tree with one of the limbs acting as a walkway that leads back into the 2nd story of the library. The limb goes directly over the cobblestone so you can walk under it. I've crossed over the limb before to explore what's in the small "tree" building- it's a small outdated apartment. I vividly remember baby blue appliances in the kitchen. There are also animal walkways/cages up high where the limb walkway is, sometimes large animals such as tigers can be seen up there.
